findings.title: Exact condition drain arithmetic
findings.summary: 11 tactic dimensions are summed from Low/Medium/High option intensities using defaults 0/5/7 plus base 15, normalized by 100; classification thresholds are strict >0.40 and >0.65.

findings.title: All 11 tactic semantic tooltips recovered
findings.summary: Build localisation explicitly describes passing, shooting, focus, crossing, possession transitions, mentality, marking, pressing, back line and tackling behaviour.

findings.title: Private best-tactic effectiveness formula
findings.summary: No authoritative client-side numerical score selecting the best tactic for a given XI has been recovered.

findings.title: Mentor effect state reaches live matches
findings.summary: Mentor snapshots are carried in JoinMatchResponse and MatchPeriod; in-match assign/unassign returns full updated mentor state.

findings.title: Seven mentor raw effect arrays captured
findings.summary: Current and next effect arrays are preserved for saboteur, wing_commander, analyst, architect, deadball_specialist, iron_guard and enforcer.

findings.title: Mentor boost units and meanings decoded
findings.summary: Localisation proves tactic boosts are percentage effectiveness values, attribute boosts are +attribute points to all players, and signature array positions have named gameplay semantics.

findings.title: Exact Football Engine consumer
findings.summary: The state/domain flow is proven, but the exact Football Engine numerical fields that consume Mentor CurrentEffects remain unresolved.

findings.title: Explicit stored set-piece duties
findings.summary: Captain, left/right corners, left/right free kicks, penalty kicker and ordered penalty takers are explicit current-client assignments.

findings.title: Automatic captain ranking
findings.summary: No authoritative automatic captain-selection formula has been recovered. Companion keeps captain manual.

findings.title: Current 12-role model and pitch rectangles
findings.summary: Current playable roles are GK, DL, DC, DR, DMC, ML, MC, MR, AML, AMC, AMR, ST with recovered 0–1000 pitch rectangles; DML/DMR are legacy/internal.

findings.title: Role key/white attributes
findings.summary: The client has role->key-attribute data; multi-role players use the union of natural-role key attributes.

findings.title: Current playstyle schema and eligibility source
findings.summary: Current playstyle IDs/levels are known; role eligibility is server-provided PlaystyleDefinition data. Ball Playing GK is not currently offered.

findings.title: Current special ability enum is 1..19
findings.summary: Current build includes Long Shots, Set Piece Taker, Versatile Attacker, Intercepting Specialist, Set Piece Stopper, Blocker, Rebound Specialist, Cross Expert and Counter Attack Stopper; Shadow Striker is absent.

findings.title: Training eligibility is player-specific
findings.summary: Client requests GetAvailableTrainingAbilitiesResponse for a specific player; no universal role->ability training matrix should be invented.

findings.title: Deterministic local skill-point distributor exists
findings.summary: Recovered 3-way group split, deterministic 48-bit LCG, state-dependent per-attribute selection, caps and ceil conversion.

findings.title: Normal ExecuteTraining final AttributeGain is server-returned
findings.summary: Current normal training response carries per-player final AttributeGain arrays; local distributor existence must not be overstated as the normal-session authority.

findings.title: Exact Windows binary identity
findings.summary: TopEleven_Full(4).zip package v27.3.0.0 has GameAssembly/global-metadata hashes identical to the previously inspected build-30527 Windows binaries.

findings.title: Analyst display name is Jonas Braun
findings.summary: Exact build localisation uses mentorName_jonasBraun / Jonas Braun. The companion previously displayed Jonas Brown; v0.5.2 corrects only the display name and leaves the internal analyst ID/effects unchanged.

findings.title: Current level override does not change effect state
findings.summary: mentor-engine effectiveMentor() changes only mentor.level; rawEffects() continues returning the captured arrays and attributeCoverage() counts the Attribute family regardless of level/availability. This can score effects that are not proven active at the overridden level.
